overall: The AG found no violation: the Chair did not reasonably anticipate discussing the office-keys topic 48 hours before the October 13 meeting, so discussing it was not an Open Meeting Law violation.

allegations.summary: A complainant alleged the Board discussed a topic, whether all members should have keys to the Board offices, that was not listed on the October 13 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Here, because we find that the Chair did not anticipate discussing the issue of the keys at least 48 hours prior to the meeting, not including Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing it during the meeting at issue.
